chunks: Do men think they will get away by saying: "We believe," and will not be tried?

key_terms.يُتْرَكُوا: they will be left / allowed to remain

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between verbal belief and tested faith in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that faith (Iman) is not a static label but a dynamic state proven through 'fitnah' (divine trials), distinguishing true believers from those who merely claim belief. It highlights the necessity of enduring hardships as a mechanism for spiritual purification and the validation of sincerity, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the path to perfection.
